Re: Claim C-1104 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents Shirley Rhodes in connection with the motor vehicle collision
that occurred on 2023-12-28 at a controlled intersection. Our client was proceeding
through the intersection on a green signal when another vehicle entered from a
crossing street and struck the driver's side of our client's car. The force of the
impact drove the vehicle sideways and threw our client against the interior, where the
left knee struck the dashboard structure.
Medical records document a torn meniscus and associated ligament strain. Our client
attended physical therapy sessions and has been advised that further treatment,
including a possible arthroscopic procedure, may be necessary. Our client has missed
significant time from work and continues to experience swelling, limited range of
motion, and difficulty with stairs and prolonged standing.
The police report confirms that the other driver admitted at the scene to failing to
yield. Independent witness statements support our client's account of the signal
phase.
Liability in this matter is clear. Our client's damages include past and future
medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering. Based on the documented injuries
and treatment to date, we demand payment of $207,000.00 to resolve all claims arising
from this incident. This offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this
letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file
suit without further notice.
Sincerely,
Counsel for Shirley Rhodes
Expert review: Jeffrey Lawrence, orthopedic surgeon
Sincerely,
Nicole Arias
Mitchell & Hines Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
